description:
Returns a paginated list of the options of this custom field, ordered by `value`.

- **Customer:** without `customer_id`, every option of the field, common and of every
  customer. With it, the common options and those of that customer.
- **Archived:** archived options are left out unless `include_archived=true`.
- **Suggestions off:** the options of a field with `suggest_values: false` are listed
  too. They are not offered on invoices while the setting is off.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key}/options (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

CustomFieldKey.description: Identifier of the custom field within the company, chosen when the field is created: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. It never changes. BeeL. gives it no meaning of its own.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

customer_id.description: Limits the list to the common options and those of this customer. A value that names no customer of this company is not an error: only the common options come back.

key.description: Key of the custom field: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. A key outside that format answers `422`.

limit.description: How many items to return per page. The response echoes it back as `pagination.items_per_page`.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The response echoes it back as `pagination.current_page`.

name: beel_list_custom_field_options
